machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory, AC power, battery charged; 5.7-5.8 GB swap in use
scope: Fixed-cost pass over the adopted 4-step path, from fable-max-review.md: generate-1024 on models/qwen-image-2.1-viggle-turbo-EXPERIMENT-fp16-v4.qipack (pack metadata kind=distilled steps=4 shift_terminal=none), cache off

input.prompt: a travel poster with the headline "CASABLANCA" and the tagline "MEET ME AT SUNSET"

baseline.description: Working tree before the pass (HEAD 2c05154 plus metadata/CLI diff)

after_ring.description: Aligned parallel text reads, prefill attention-output row split, VAE MPS attention and pread weights, VAE upsample scratch reuse, PNG writer, block-weight ring; MPSGraph SDPA
after_ring.png_vs_baseline: 45 of 4,194,304 RGBA bytes differ by one level (PSNR 96.6 dB), from the VAE attention change; everything else byte-identical

steel_attention_cached_steps.description: MLX steel attention (v0.32.2, MIT) replaces MPSGraph SDPA on cached steps
steel_attention_cached_steps.caveat: The machine was warm after a 1024/40 oracle run; the single end-to-end run measured 39.52 s with steps 3-4 at 8.5-8.9 s

final_default.description: All of the above plus steel attention on cached steps; prefill on MPSGraph. Quiet GPU, 30 s pause before each run

powered_confirmation.description: Fresh-process end-to-end confirmation after rebuilding the current worktree; AC power, battery charged at 100%
powered_confirmation.interpretation: 1.14 seconds slower than the 38.18-second best run but confirms the same output and roughly 38-39-second operating range

steel_attention_prefill.verdict: slower overall, and later cached steps slow to 10.2-11 s although their code path is unchanged; mechanism unknown; kept opt-in as QI_STEEL_PREFILL=1, off by default

gates.note: The 256/40 and 1024/40 values include the BF16 timestep double-rounding fix (previously 0.0107623 and 0.13211)
